title: CI artifacts caching and dependency pins
focus: Resolve artifacts/retention/timeout/cache/immutable dependency checks and current native-host replacement workflow. Inspect GitHub read-only via available tools or gh if authenticated; prepare concrete workflow patches, no remote mutations or shared build execution.
